method: Read-only queries (mode=ro URI connections) against live production database/flex_complete_database.db, database/wt_ops_v2.db, and database/local_operation_discovery_corpus.db while all 3 writer services (watchtower_listener, creator_funding_worker, watchtower_api) were RUNNING. Zero writes issued. Indexed queries used where a suitable index existed (idx_transfer_block_time); the full-row pin-set classification pass required a single bounded fetch of the 90-day-old row set (318,948 rows) held in process memory, not a per-row query -- completed in ~9s.

cold_segment_snapshot_at_census_time.note: 89 total *.sqlite files present in database/_p5a_migration_build/cold_segments/, 45 pass the ColdSegmentRegistry qualification gate (segment_manifest row with closed_at NOT NULL); the remainder are open/unclosed delta staging segments from prior P5B work, correctly excluded by the registry.

pin_dimension_sizes_at_census_time.note: creator_funders count (21612) differs slightly from the 21777 recorded in storage_lifecycle_p5b_delta_reconciliation.json -- expected drift over the intervening period between P5B and P5D census passes, not a discrepancy requiring investigation.

90_day_boundary.query: SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(block_time) FROM transfer_index WHERE block_time IS NOT NULL AND block_time>0 AND block_time < ? (idx_transfer_block_time used, 0.62s)

eligibility_breakdown.estimated_bytes_note: 9590 rows * ~120 bytes/row rough in-row estimate (excludes index overhead); a precise on-disk figure requires a real COLD write, not attempted against production per the read-only boundary for this part.

eligible_backlog_month_by_month_distribu.note: Heavily skewed toward the most recent eligible month (2026-05, just past the 90-day boundary) -- 95% of the generic backlog is concentrated there, consistent with P5C's growth observations that most transfer_index volume is recent.

interpretation: The eligible backlog is small in absolute terms (9,590 rows against a 3.69M-row HOT table, ~0.26%) because the vast majority of old rows are pinned (96.8%) -- creator_funders alone covers 21,612 addresses, and any row touching a known creator, a Watchtower operator entity, or a discovery-corpus signature stays HOT regardless of age. This confirms the P4/P5B pinning design is doing its job: HOT is NOT accumulating unboundedly with generic noise, it is accumulating pinned (permanently retained) rows, which is the expected and correct steady-state behavior documented in the Part 28 growth model.
production_safety_confirmation: Zero writes issued to database/flex_complete_database.db, database/wt_ops_v2.db, or database/local_operation_discovery_corpus.db during this census. All connections opened with mode=ro URIs. Total wall time across all census queries: approximately 35 seconds, non-blocking to the 3 live writer services (plain SELECTs, no write lock requested).
